en.name: YourTube: Watch & Discover
en.short_description: Watch trending videos, search by topic and save them to Watch Later.
en.subtitle: Watch, search and save videos
en.description:
YourTube brings trending public videos into one simple player on your phone, tablet or TV.

WATCH
Browse what is trending, explore by category, or search for something specific. Dailymotion videos play in Dailymotion's own embedded player, right inside the app.

FOR YOU
A recommendation feed that learns from what you watch and search for. That history is stored only on your device, and you can clear it in Settings.

SAVE IT
Save any video to Watch Later from a video card, the player or your search results. Your Watch Later list, likes and watch history stay on this device between launches. Mark a video "Not interested" and it stops appearing in your feeds.

MADE FOR THE BIG SCREEN TOO
YourTube detects a TV and switches to a layout you can drive with a remote.

Sign in with Google or Apple, or continue as a guest.

review_information.notes:
2. DEVICES AND OS VERSIONS TESTED
Automated tests run on every build: iPhone 17 Pro Max and iPad Pro 13-inch simulators on iOS 26, and a Pixel Android emulator on API 34.
Each release is also installed and launched on those targets, so a
build that cannot start never ships.

3. WHAT THIS APP DOES, AND FOR WHOM
YourTube brings trending public videos into one simple player on your phone, tablet or TV.

Intended audience:
Watch, search and save videos

4. SETTING UP AND REACHING THE MAIN FEATURES
The app opens on a sign-in screen. An account is optional; the main features can be reached without signing in.

5. EXTERNAL SERVICES USED
- Google Sign-In — authentication
- Sign in with Apple — authentication
- Supabase — sign-in and accounts only (email, Google, Apple and guest sessions). Watch Later, likes and watch history stay on the device
- Dailymotion public API (api.dailymotion.com) — video lists, search and categories. Dailymotion videos play in Dailymotion's own embedded web player, loaded in an in-app web view
- Pexels API (api.pexels.com) and Pixabay API (pixabay.com) — additional videos, only in builds made with their API keys
- Firebase (Google) — Crashlytics crash reporting, Analytics, Performance Monitoring and Remote Config
- Google Mobile Ads SDK and Google's consent form (UMP) — included and initialised, but no ad units are configured in this build, so the app requests and shows no ads

6. REGIONAL DIFFERENCES
The app follows the device language for 12 locales (Arabic, Chinese (Simplified), English, French, German, Hindi, Italian, Japanese, Korean, Portuguese, Russian, Spanish), but translation is partial: shared labels are translated, while most screen text is in English only. Features are identical in every region.

7. REGULATED INDUSTRY OR THIRD-PARTY MATERIAL

The app is not in a regulated industry. It does show third-party material: the videos, thumbnails, titles and channel names come from Dailymotion's public API (and from Pexels and Pixabay in builds that have their API keys). The app does not host, re-upload or redistribute any of it. Dailymotion videos play only in Dailymotion's own embedded player, under Dailymotion's terms, with its controls and branding intact, and links that leave the player open in the browser. YourTube is not affiliated with YouTube, Google or Dailymotion.


ACCOUNT DELETION
Account deletion is available in the app under Settings, and on the support site.

HOW TO REACH THE APP AS A GUEST
On the sign-in screen, tap "Continue as guest", below the "Sign in with Apple" and "Continue with Google" buttons. This creates an anonymous session and opens the app; no account details are asked for. The demo account in App Review Information can instead be entered in the email and password fields at the top of the same screen.

LANGUAGE OF APP-SPECIFIC TEXT
The languages listed in section 6 cover the shared interface text (sign-in, Settings, common buttons and messages). Text specific to YourTube is in English in every language. Video titles and descriptions appear in whatever language the uploader used.

THIRD-PARTY CONTENT
All videos are public videos published by third parties on Dailymotion (and on Pexels and Pixabay when those keys are set). Users cannot upload anything to YourTube. The menu on each video card offers "Not interested", which hides the video, and "Report", which sends a report by email.

_blocker.gate: DO NOT SUBMIT THIS LISTING until a human has checked it against a build. The default build shows no sample or placeholder content: feeds come from Dailymotion's public API (played in Dailymotion's embedded player), and from Pexels only when PEXELS_API_KEY is set. Without that key the Shorts tab is empty ('No shorts available'), so the copy no longer mentions short-form video. On 2026-10-11 the copy was rewritten to drop claims the app did not back: captions, a play queue, a data-saver mode, 'stock video', 'keep your list across devices' (Watch Later is stored on the device only; there is no server sync), and 'YourTube shows ads' (no ad units are configured).
_blocker.why: video_api_service.dart returns no sample videos; Pexels is skipped when AppConstants.pexelsConfigured is false. Most content is Dailymotion uploads, not stock footage. The content is third-party video, not user uploads to this app — the name invites a comparison the app does not make, and Apple may read it as one.

1. WHAT IT DOES
YourTube is a video browser for trending public videos (Dailymotion), on phone, tablet or TV.
Screens it contains: auth, categories, for you, home, player, search, settings, shorts, trending, watch later

2. INTENDED USER
People who want to browse and watch trending public videos (Dailymotion) in one simple player on a phone, a tablet or a TV, where the app switches to a layout that can be driven with a remote. They search, explore by category, get a recommendation feed based on what they watch, and keep a Watch Later list. Watch history and saved videos stay on the device, and guests can use it without signing in.

5. STANDALONE OR PART OF A SUITE
Part of a suite: 43 apps are published under this developer account.
Category: ENTERTAINMENT.

This app's scope differs from the rest measurably, not just by description:

  - Screens unique to it: categories, for you, player, shorts, watch later
  - Closest other app by implementation: PilotEnRoute at 47%
    similarity of non-generic widget and class usage
  - Across all 43 apps the median pairwise similarity is 28%, and
    no pair exceeds 85%

Both numbers exclude the ~60 widgets every Flutter app uses — Column, Text,
Padding and so on. Including them makes any two Flutter apps look 97% alike,
which is a property of the framework rather than of these apps.

The store copy is distinct on the same basis: no two of the 43 share more
than 22% of their description vocabulary.

7. CODE SHARED WITH OUR OTHER APPS
Yes, infrastructure only: agl_i18n (shared translations); agl_ads (ad mediation); agl_observability (crash reporting). It also uses the same Supabase project as our other apps for sign-in. No screens, features or content are shared; the similarity figure in 5 measures exactly that.

8. CODE SHARED WITH THIRD-PARTY APPS
No, beyond standard third-party frameworks: flutter_localizations, flutter_svg, google_fonts, google_mobile_ads, google_sign_in, sign_in_with_apple, supabase_flutter.
